notable_absence.finding: This ROLES catalogue is missing every Server 8.0-introduced role the registry excerpt documents: no role:ro-security-admin, role:user-admin-local, role:user-admin-external (the three-way 8.0 split of the pre-8.0 security/user-admin roles), no role:external-stats-reader, and none of the six 7.0.2+ fine-grained Sync Gateway roles (role:sync-gateway-app, role:sync-gateway-app-ro, role:sync-gateway-configurator, role:sync-gateway-dev-ops, role:sync-gateway-replicator - only the older, coarser role:mobile-sync-gateway appears). For a page served under server/current (resolved to 8.0) that otherwise enumerates roughly 30 roles in detail, omitting an entire generation of RBAC roles introduced specifically for security administration is a substantial, version-shaped gap - not a thin page, a stale one.

cross_component_finding: This page is the batch's strongest evidence for the round's RBAC-citation-consistency hypothesis, in four independent ways. (1) role:security-admin CONTRADICTION: this page's security_admin entry reads 'Gives the user permission to view all cluster statistics and manage user roles, but cannot grant Full Admin or Security Admin roles to other users or alter their own role' - but the registry's own promoted definition of role:security-admin (introduced in Server 8.0) states it 'CANNOT manage users (that's role:user-admin-local/external)'. The CLI's internal name `security_admin` is described here in terms of managing user roles - the pre-8.0 combined Security Admin behavior - while the SAME internal name in 8.0's actual RBAC model denotes the narrower, user-management-excluded role. This is exactly a role citation that does not cleanly map onto the current 56-role catalogue. (2) DUPLICATE, INCONSISTENT ENTRY: replication_admin is documented TWICE on this single page under two different section headers with two different descriptions - under 'Cluster-Wide Roles': 'Allows the user to configure XDCR topology and manage XDCR replications.'; under 'XDCR roles': 'Allows the user to administer XDCR features, create cluster references and replication streams of the cluster. This user can access the console and read some data.' Neither description mentions the other's specific claims (topology configuration vs. console/data access), and a reader would have no way to know these are the same role. (3) STALE TERMINOLOGY: analytics_admin is described as managing 'dataverses' - the pre-8.0 term the registry's own analytics:analytics-scope record says Server 8.0 renamed to 'Analytics scope' ('dataverse' is 'the pre-8.0 term, still accepted in some REST parameters'). Using the retired term as the PRIMARY description in a page served under the 8.0 docs tree is a version-drift finding. (4) MISSING DEPRECATION WARNING: bucket_full_access is presented as a normal, unremarkable role option ('Gives the user full access to bucket data... intended only for application access') with no hint that roles.md itself marks this role DEPRECATED ('Do not grant this role to users', per the registry). A user copying this page's own guidance would have no way to know the role they are about to grant is deprecated. Separately from the RBAC content, the page has two independent SYNOPSIS defects: `--group-name` is used in OPTIONS and in the worked EXAMPLES but is entirely absent from the SYNOPSIS bracket list, and the SYNOPSIS contains a literal spacing typo `[-- get]` (extra space) where every other flag is written `[--flag]`.
cross_product_finding: role:mobile-sync-gateway's registry note already states it is the SIXTH structurally distinct thing this ontology calls 'role', separate from sgw:role (Sync Gateway's own internal channel-grant construct) - this page's own description ('intended only for use by Sync Gateway... read and write data, manage indexes and views, and read some cluster information') is fully consistent with that promoted description and adds no new terminology, unlike the analytics/security findings above. No other Capella/Mobile terminology drift observed on this page.
